eyeLevel.title: Eye level
eyeLevel.instruction: Hold the camera level with the main subject.

slightlyHigh.title: Slightly high
slightlyHigh.instruction: Raise the camera slightly and angle it down gently.

low.title: Low angle
low.instruction: Lower the camera and angle it upward gently.

overhead.title: Overhead
overhead.instruction: Hold the camera directly above and parallel to the subject.

fortyFive.title: 45-degree angle
fortyFive.instruction: Photograph from slightly above and off to one side.

side.title: From the side
side.instruction: Move to one side while keeping the subject clearly framed.

softEven.title: Soft, even front light
softEven.instruction: Face the subject toward a large window or another broad, diffused light source.

softSide.title: Soft light from 45° to one side
softSide.instruction: Place a window or diffused light about 45 degrees to the side of the subject's face.

openShade.title: Bright open shade
openShade.instruction: Move into open shade while keeping the subjects facing the brighter open sky.

goldenHour.title: Soft golden-hour light
goldenHour.instruction: Use low, soft sunlight from the side or behind, and keep every face evenly exposed.

broadEven.title: Broad, even light across every face
broadEven.instruction: Use a broad light source far enough back to illuminate every face evenly.

sunriseSunset.title: Sunrise or sunset
sunriseSunset.instruction: Use low side light to reveal shape, depth, and natural texture.

mistySideLight.title: Sunrise, sunset, or mist
mistySideLight.instruction: Look for side light or mist that separates each ridge.

blueHour.title: Sunrise or blue hour
blueHour.instruction: Stabilize the phone and preserve the cool color in sky and water.

sunset.title: Sunset
sunset.instruction: Expose for the bright sky while retaining visible foreground detail.

goldenHour.title: Golden hour
goldenHour.instruction: Use warm side light to add depth without losing highlight detail.

softOvercast.title: Soft overcast
softOvercast.instruction: Use even cloud light to preserve natural color and fine detail.

items.name: relaxedStanding
items.title: Relaxed standing
cues: Stand with your feet comfortably apart.
Relax your shoulders.

items.name: threeQuarter
items.title: Three-quarter stance
cues: Turn your body slightly to your right.
Bring your face back toward the camera.

items.name: handInPocket
items.title: One hand in pocket
cues: Rest one hand in your pocket.
Let your other arm hang loosely.

items.name: seatedLean
items.title: Seated forward lean
cues: Sit and lean slightly forward.
Rest your forearms on your thighs.

items.name: walking
items.title: Casual walking
cues: Walk slowly across the frame.
Look toward the camera for the next shot.

items.name: armsCrossedMasculine
items.title: Relaxed arms crossed
cues: Cross your arms loosely at mid-torso.
Drop your shoulders and keep your hands relaxed.

items.name: wallLeanMasculine
items.title: Casual wall lean
cues: Lean one shoulder lightly against the wall.
Bend the outside knee and relax your hands.

items.name: seatedSidewaysMasculine
items.title: Seated sideways
cues: Sit sideways with both feet visible.
Turn your upper body comfortably toward the camera.

items.name: lookAwayMasculine
items.title: Natural look away
cues: Angle your body slightly away from the camera.
Look naturally just past the camera.

items.name: weightShift
items.title: Weight-shift stance
cues: Rest your weight on one leg.
Soften the other knee.

items.name: footForward
items.title: One foot forward
cues: Place one foot slightly in front.
Turn your shoulders a little toward the camera.

items.name: handAtWaist
items.title: Hand at waist
cues: Rest one hand lightly at your waist.
Relax your other arm.

items.name: seatedAngle
items.title: Seated angled pose
cues: Sit with your knees angled slightly to one side.
Turn your face toward the camera.

items.name: overShoulder
items.title: Over-shoulder glance
cues: Turn your body partly away from the camera.
Look back over your shoulder comfortably.

items.name: armsCrossedFeminine
items.title: Relaxed arms crossed
cues: Cross your arms loosely at mid-torso.
Drop your shoulders and keep your hands relaxed.

items.name: wallLeanFeminine
items.title: Casual wall lean
cues: Lean one shoulder lightly against the wall.
Bend the outside knee and relax your hands.

items.name: walkingTurnFeminine
items.title: Walking turn
cues: Take a slow step away from the camera.
Turn your face and shoulders gently back toward it.

items.name: seatedSidewaysFeminine
items.title: Seated sideways
cues: Sit sideways with both feet visible.
Turn your upper body comfortably toward the camera.

items.name: hairSweepFeminine
items.title: Gentle hair sweep
cues: Lift one hand lightly into your hair.
Keep your fingers relaxed and your face visible.

items.name: handNearCheekFeminine
items.title: Hand near cheek
cues: Bring relaxed fingertips beside your cheek.
Keep your eyes and jawline uncovered.

items.name: armAcrossWaistFeminine
items.title: Arm across waist
cues: Rest one forearm softly across your waist.
Let your other arm hang freely.

items.name: handsClaspedFeminine
items.title: Hands loosely clasped
cues: Clasp your hands loosely below your waist.
Move them slightly to one side and relax your shoulders.

items.name: coupleCloseStanding
items.title: Close standing
cues: Stand close with your shoulders lightly touching.
Turn both faces toward the camera and relax your outside arms.

items.name: coupleArmAroundWaist
items.title: Arm around waist
cues: Stand slightly staggered with one partner just behind the other.
Place one arm gently around the front partner's waist.

items.name: coupleBackToBack
items.title: Back to back
cues: Stand back to back with light contact at your shoulders.
Angle outward slightly and turn both faces toward the camera.

items.name: coupleWalking
items.title: Walking hand in hand
cues: Hold hands and take a slow step together.
Look at each other while keeping your joined hands visible.

items.name: coupleSeated
items.title: Seated together
cues: Sit close with your shoulders touching and bodies angled inward.
Keep both sets of hands relaxed and visible.

items.name: coupleForeheadTouch
items.title: Forehead to forehead
cues: Turn toward each other and step comfortably close.
Touch foreheads lightly and rest your hands on each other's upper arms.

items.name: groupShoulderRow
items.title: Shoulder-to-shoulder row
cues: Stand shoulder to shoulder in one relaxed row.
Close the gaps slightly and keep every face visible.

items.name: groupStaggered
items.title: Staggered triangle
cues: Place one person slightly forward and the others just behind on each side.
Angle everyone gently inward and keep all faces visible.

items.name: groupLinkedWalk
items.title: Linked-arm walk
cues: Link arms loosely and take a slow step together.
Look toward one another while keeping every face visible.

items.name: groupSeatedCluster
items.title: Seated cluster
cues: Sit close with the center person slightly forward.
Angle the outside people inward and keep every set of hands visible.

items.name: groupCelebration
items.title: Celebration
cues: Stand close and raise your hands at different heights.
Keep every face visible and hold the pose for the next shot.

items.name: groupConversation
items.title: Casual conversation
cues: Stand in a loose semicircle facing one another.
Keep gestures small so every face stays visible.

items.name: familyStandingRow
items.title: Family standing row
cues: Stand in one relaxed row with shorter family members near the center.
Close the gaps gently and keep every face visible.

items.name: familySideHug
items.title: Caregiver side hug
cues: Stand side by side and bring your faces comfortably closer in height.
Add a gentle side hug and turn both faces toward the camera.

items.name: familySeatedCluster
items.title: Family seated cluster
cues: Sit close with younger family members slightly forward.
Angle everyone inward and keep hands and faces visible.

items.name: familyWalking
items.title: Walking hand in hand
cues: Hold hands with the youngest family member in the center.
Take one slow step together and look toward one another.

items.name: familyGenerations
items.title: Generations together
cues: Seat one family member near the center and arrange the others close behind and beside them.
Angle everyone inward and keep every face unobstructed.

items.name: familySharedLaugh
items.title: Shared family laugh
cues: Stand in a loose cluster and turn gently toward one another.
Share a small laugh while keeping every face visible.

items.name: graduationDiplomaCentered
items.title: Diploma centered
cues: Hold the diploma folder with both hands at mid-torso.
Stand tall and relax your shoulders.

items.name: graduationAdjustCap
items.title: Adjust the cap
cues: Turn slightly and touch the edge of your cap with relaxed fingertips.
Hold the diploma at your side and bring your face back toward the camera.

items.name: graduationSeated
items.title: Seated with diploma
cues: Sit upright with your body angled slightly.
Rest the diploma across one thigh and keep both feet comfortably planted.

items.name: graduationWalk
items.title: Graduation walk
cues: Hold the diploma at your side and take one slow step.
Look toward the camera and let the gown move naturally.

items.name: graduationOverShoulder
items.title: Over-shoulder graduate
cues: Turn partly away with the diploma held low at your side.
Look back over your shoulder comfortably.

items.name: graduationCapToss
items.title: Cap toss
cues: Keep both feet grounded and gently toss the cap just above your hand.
Follow the cap with your eyes while holding the diploma at your side.

items.name: maternityBellyCradle
items.title: Belly cradle
cues: Stand with both feet comfortably apart and soften your shoulders.
Rest one hand above and one hand below your belly.

items.name: maternitySideProfile
items.title: Side profile
cues: Turn to the side with both feet flat and your posture comfortable.
Cradle your belly lightly and turn your face a little toward the camera.

items.name: maternitySeatedSupport
items.title: Comfortable seated
cues: Sit near the front of a sturdy seat with both feet planted.
Angle your body slightly and rest your hands comfortably around your belly.

items.name: maternityHusbandEmbrace
items.title: Embrace with husband
cues: Have your husband stand just behind and to one side with both of you balanced.
Rest your hands gently around the belly and turn your faces toward each other.

items.name: maternityHusbandWalk
items.title: Walk with husband
cues: Hold hands and take one small, slow step together on level ground.
Look toward each other and keep the expecting parent's free hand comfortable.

items.name: maternityHusbandFaceToFace
items.title: Face-to-face with husband
cues: Stand face-to-face with both feet planted and shoulders relaxed.
Let your husband rest his hands gently on your upper arms and bring your foreheads close if comfortable.

items.name: kidsBigSmile
items.title: Big smile
cues: Stand with both feet comfortably apart and place your hands loosely behind your back.
Look toward the camera and share a smile that feels natural.

items.name: kidsComfortableSeated
items.title: Comfortable seated
cues: Sit near the front of a sturdy seat with both feet flat.
Rest your hands loosely together and turn your face toward the camera.

items.name: kidsSlowWalk
items.title: Slow walk
cues: Take one small, slow step toward the camera on clear, level ground.
Let your arms swing naturally and look toward the camera.

items.name: kidsPeekAround
items.title: Peek around
cues: Keep both feet on the ground and peek around the side without climbing.
Touch the surface lightly and keep your whole face visible.

items.name: kidsSuperhero
items.title: Superhero stance
cues: Plant both feet comfortably wide and place your hands on your hips.
Keep both feet grounded, lift your chin slightly, and give a proud smile.

items.name: kidsSiblingSideHug
items.title: Sibling side hug
cues: Stand side by side with both sets of feet steady.
Add a gentle side hug if comfortable and keep both faces visible.

items.name: newbornSafeBack
items.title: Safe back pose
cues: Place the baby on their back in an empty safety-approved bassinet with a fitted sheet only.
Keep the face uncovered and photograph from outside the bassinet.

items.name: newbornCaregiverNearby
items.title: Caregiver nearby
cues: Keep the baby on their back on a firm, flat crib mattress with a caregiver within reach.
Let the baby move naturally without repositioning the head or limbs.

items.name: newbornSeatedCradle
items.title: Seated cradle
cues: Sit securely and cradle the baby with continuous head, neck, and body support.
Keep the face and nose clear while you look gently toward the baby.

items.name: newbornShoulderSupport
items.title: Shoulder support
cues: Sit securely and support the upright baby's head and neck with one hand and body with the other.
Keep the baby's face turned outward enough that the nose and mouth stay clear.

items.name: newbornParentsSeated
items.title: Parents seated together
cues: Sit together while one parent cradles the baby with full head and neck support.
Have the other parent lean in gently while keeping every face visible.

items.name: newbornHandsFeetDetail
items.title: Hands and feet detail
cues: Keep the baby on their back on a firm, flat crib mattress with a caregiver within reach.
Frame the hands and covered feet without holding or bending the baby's limbs.

items.name: professionalClassicHeadshot
items.title: Classic headshot
cues: Turn your shoulders slightly away from the camera.
Bring your face back toward the lens and relax your jaw.

items.name: professionalThreeQuarter
items.title: Three-quarter professional
cues: Turn your body about one-third away from the camera.
Bring your face back toward the lens and keep both shoulders relaxed.

items.name: professionalSeatedForward
items.title: Seated forward
cues: Sit near the front of the chair and lean forward slightly.
Rest your forearms lightly on your thighs and keep your hands relaxed.

items.name: professionalArmsCrossed
items.title: Relaxed arms crossed
cues: Cross your arms loosely at mid-torso.
Lower your shoulders and keep your fingers visible and relaxed.

items.name: professionalOpenStanding
items.title: Open standing
cues: Stand tall with your feet comfortably apart.
Let both arms rest naturally and keep your shoulders open.

items.name: professionalEnvironmental
items.title: Workplace portrait
cues: Turn your body slightly toward the workspace.
Rest one hand lightly on a nearby surface and bring your face back toward the camera.

items.name: weddingFormalSideBySide
items.title: Formal side by side
cues: Stand side by side with your shoulders lightly touching.
Join your inside hands at waist height and turn both faces toward the camera.

items.name: weddingRingReveal
items.title: Ring reveal
cues: Angle toward each other and bring the ring hand naturally to mid-torso.
Keep the ring hand relaxed and both faces visible.

items.name: weddingProposalReaction
items.title: One-knee proposal
cues: On a flat, clear surface, lower onto one knee with your front foot planted.
Hold the open ring box at mid-torso and turn both faces enough for the camera to see.

items.name: weddingRingExchange
items.title: Exchange rings
cues: Face each other and center your hands comfortably between you.
Slide the ring on gently while keeping both faces visible.

items.name: weddingFirstDance
items.title: First dance
cues: Stand in a comfortable dance hold with both feet grounded.
Keep your joined hands visible and angle both faces slightly toward the camera.

items.name: weddingCelebrationWalk
items.title: Celebration walk
cues: Hold hands and take one slow step together.
Look toward each other and carry any bouquet low at the outside hip.

items.name: mountainTrail
items.title: Foreground trail to peak
cues: Lower the camera near the trail.
Use the trail to lead toward the peak.
items.safetyNote: Stay on a stable marked trail; do not step into vegetation for a lower angle.

items.name: layeredRidges
items.title: Layered ridgelines
cues: Frame several overlapping ridges.
Keep the brightest ridge away from the center.
items.safetyNote: Use an established overlook and remain behind every barrier.

items.name: peakOpenSky
items.title: Peak with open sky
cues: Place the peak below the center.
Leave clean sky around its outline.
items.safetyNote: Change the framing from a safe position instead of climbing for a clearer outline.

items.name: valleyAbove
items.title: Valley from above
cues: Include the valley foreground.
Keep the horizon level and away from the center.
items.safetyNote: Never approach a cliff edge; use a protected overlook for the elevated view.

items.name: personScale
items.title: Person for scale
cues: Place the person away from the peak.
Step back until the landscape remains dominant.
items.safetyNote: Keep the person on a broad safe trail and away from drop-offs.

items.name: mountainDetail
items.title: Mountain detail
cues: Isolate one ridge, texture, or patch of light.
Remove distracting edges.
items.safetyNote: Zoom or reframe from stable ground rather than approaching loose rock.

items.name: lakeReflection
items.title: Centered reflection
cues: Center the shoreline horizontally.
Keep the reflected peak or trees fully visible.
items.safetyNote: Stay on a stable dry shoreline and never enter the water for symmetry.

items.name: lakeForegroundRocks
items.title: Foreground rocks
cues: Lower the camera near stable dry rocks.
Use them to lead into the water.
items.safetyNote: Use dry stable rocks from shore; do not climb wet rocks or enter the water.

items.name: lakeCurvingShoreline
items.title: Curving shoreline
cues: Follow the shoreline through the frame.
Keep its far end visible.
items.safetyNote: Use an established path or overlook and avoid unstable banks.

items.name: lakeMinimal
items.title: Minimal water and sky
cues: Simplify the frame to water, horizon, and sky.
Remove shoreline clutter.
items.safetyNote: Compose from a safe public shoreline and remain back from soft or eroded edges.

items.name: lakeReeds
items.title: Reeds at the water's edge
cues: Place the reeds along one edge.
Keep open water visible beyond them.
items.safetyNote: Stay on the boardwalk or dry bank; do not enter reeds or wetlands.

items.name: lakeWaterTexture
items.title: Moving water texture
cues: Fill the frame with ripples or flow.
Avoid bright reflections at the edges.
items.safetyNote: Angle downward from stable ground without leaning over a bank or railing.

items.name: plainPath
items.title: Path through the field
cues: Place the path near a lower corner.
Let it lead toward the distance.
items.safetyNote: Remain on the established path and respect field boundaries.

items.name: plainOpenSky
items.title: Large open sky
cues: Place the horizon low.
Keep the strongest cloud or color away from dead center.
items.safetyNote: Use a designated pullout or public path, never an active roadway.

items.name: plainRepeatingRows
items.title: Repeating rows
cues: Align the rows into the distance.
Keep their convergence point visible.
items.safetyNote: Photograph from an authorized edge and do not enter or damage crops.

items.name: plainSingleTree
items.title: Single tree
cues: Isolate the tree against open space.
Leave breathing room around its canopy.
items.safetyNote: Stay on public ground and do not cross fences to improve the angle.

items.name: plainForegroundTexture
items.title: Grass or flowers in front
cues: Focus on the nearest grass or flowers.
Keep enough distant field to show depth.
items.safetyNote: Keep to the path so grass, flowers, and habitat remain undisturbed.

items.name: plainLayeredColors
items.title: Layered field colors
cues: Stack color bands across the frame.
Keep their boundaries clean and level.
items.safetyNote: Use a protected overlook and remain behind barriers and fences.

items.name: plantGardenPath
items.title: Garden path
cues: Use the path as a leading line.
Keep its destination visible.
items.safetyNote: Stay on the maintained garden path and keep access clear for others.

items.name: plantPortrait
items.title: Single plant portrait
cues: Move to the plant's height.
Choose a clean background behind it.
items.safetyNote: Do not touch, bend, or move the plant to clean the background.

items.name: plantBacklitLeaves
items.title: Backlit leaves
cues: Place the light behind the leaves.
Shift sideways until the edges glow without losing detail.
items.safetyNote: Shift only along the maintained path; do not step into planting beds.

items.name: plantPattern
items.title: Repeating pattern
cues: Fill the frame with the pattern.
Keep rows and edges aligned.
items.safetyNote: Use the path edge for the overhead view and never step into the bed.

items.name: plantLayeredFoliage
items.title: Layered foliage
cues: Separate foreground, middle, and background plants.
Avoid merging the main leaf shapes.
items.safetyNote: Compose from the path without pushing through or rearranging foliage.

items.name: plantDetail
items.title: Flower or leaf detail
cues: Move close enough to simplify the frame.
Keep the key petal or leaf edge sharp.
items.safetyNote: Move the phone, not the plant; avoid touching petals, stems, or leaves.
